PARTIALs:

- Personal items: not named.

A single weekly kitchen-premises checklist plus about five storage questions would close almost all PARTIALs and both GAPs.

Facts the parent should know:
1. The pack has 12 templates, not 13. CHK-COLDROOM-DAILY appears only as placeholder text (src/app/fssai/settings/checklists/[id]/page.tsx:1255; src/lib/db.ts:8933).

Inspection Mode shows each checklist round only as name, date, status and failed count (src/app/fssai/inspection-mode/page.tsx:366-394), capped at 25 rows over 7–90 days, with no link into the run sheet. 27 items in my three sections: 12 CHECKED, 6 RECORDED, 8 PARTIAL, 1 GAP.

Temperature Control (7): Receiving, Refrigerators, Freezers, Hot holding, Cooking and Reheating are RECORDED in fssai_temperature_logs, via /fssai/temperature, /fssai/cold-rooms and /fssai/receiving. Receiving probes are also mirrored into the register. All six are visible in inspection mode 'Temperature records' and the 'Temperature register' PDF report. Cooling is PARTIAL:
- Any reading taken while food is still cooling is recorded as a breach, because the level check ignores the clock (_p4/lib.ts:244-247). Each one forces an 'action taken' and raises a corrective action.
- Nothing links one batch's readings into a curve: no start time or start temperature.
- Elapsed minutes are not printed on the register or in inspection mode.

Defects found:
- CHK-STORE-COLD-DAILY Q12 asks for the 'Coldest chiller reading', which hides a warm unit (pack:527); its own help text says 'warmest'.
- The hot-holding register standard is 60 C, but both checklists use 65 C.
- Checklist temperature answers never reach fssai_temperature_logs (the only writers are temperature and receiving).
- Fridge and freezer readings are judged only if the unit is in the equipment register. Otherwise they file as 'not judged'.
- The only delivery standard is chilled (max 5 C), so frozen deliveries are not judged against freezer limits.

Food Preparation (9):
- GAP: 'Raw materials washed/cleaned properly'. No question or record anywhere.
- PARTIAL: cross-contamination (tools and storage are asked, the prep station is not), food covered (storage only, not during prep), no bare-hand contact with ready-to-eat food (Q08 asks for separate gloves, not for avoiding bare hands).
- CHECKED: separate boards and knives, handwashing before prep, cooking temperature, reheating, no expired ingredients.

Personal Hygiene (11): CHK-HYG-SHIFT checks uniform, hairnet/cap, nails, jewellery, wound dressing, smoking/spitting and illness. Three lines are PARTIAL:
- Apron: Q04 says 'uniform OR apron', so a handler without an apron passes.
- Handwashing practice: asked once at shift start; the soap and drying checks cover washroom basins only, not the kitchen hand-wash station.
- Medical and training records: the document types exist, but a person document must belong to an app user (users.email; locally 9 users, 0 hr_employees). Handlers without a login cannot be named, there is no list of who is missing a certificate, and inspection mode does not show whose certificate it is. HRMS hr_trainings is not linked to the FSSAI module.

Inspector visibility: temperature records, deliveries and documents are reachable from inspection mode and the reports. Every checklist-only line is not. Inspection mode and 'Checklist records' show rounds only (name, answered n/m, failed count, signed). Only failed answers appear in a report ('Failed answers'). A passing answer such as 'nails short' can be seen only by opening /fssai/checklists/run/[id], which nothing in inspection mode or the reports links to, and no single round can be printed. Inspection mode also caps each section at the 25 most recent rows, with temperature kinds mixed together.

- The pack seeds as draft by default (fssai-seed-server.ts:300), so the owner must publish each one.

summaries.summary:
Scope: 44 authority items across my four sections. Result: CHECKED 18, RECORDED 3, PARTIAL 15, GAP 8. This was read-only; the only file created is a database snapshot at /tmp/fssai-lane-csw/snap.db.

By section:
- Cleaning & Sanitation: well covered by CHK-CLEAN-KITCHEN-DAILY and CHK-CLEAN-WASHROOM (14 CHECKED, 1 RECORDED).
  - GAP: Sinks.
  - PARTIAL: Walls (weekly only), Exhaust/hood (daily question allows N/A; canopy only weekly), Crockery/cutlery (only cutlery trays), Water station (only jugs).
- Pest Control: the monthly visit is RECORDED and visible in Inspection Mode; drains and grease traps are CHECKED. The other 7 are PARTIAL.
  - Pest-absence questions exist only for the dry store (pack.ts:491) and the guest area (pack.ts:364). There is no kitchen or prep pest check at all.
  - No template uses module_key 'pest-control', although pest/devices/route.ts:13-18 and db.ts:9982-9987 claim a seeded 'weekly monitoring round'. Bait stations are therefore never routinely checked.
  - Chemicals are effectively not captured: fssai_pest_services.chemicals_json has no UI writer (the form at pest-control/page.tsx:1209-1217 never sends it), and neither the report nor Inspection Mode shows chemicals.
- Waste Management: lids, bin cleaning and daily removal are CHECKED; used-oil disposal is RECORDED (fssai_oil_disposals, report 'oil-disposals'), though not in Inspection Mode.
  - GAP: wet/dry segregation.
  - PARTIAL: overflowing bins, waste area clean (Q10 asks 'cleared'), waste near prep areas. All three lack an in-service question.
- Food-Grade Equipment & Packaging: 6 GAP, 1 PARTIAL. No template asks about food-grade material, rust or damage on equipment, delivery packaging, or newspaper. Packaging storage is only touched by generic dry-store questions.

Preconditions that apply to every CHECKED item:
1. Nothing is seeded locally. The snapshot has 0 rows in fssai_templates, fssai_seed_log, fssai_assignments and every record table.
2. When the pack is applied it seeds DRAFTS by default, which staff cannot see until each is published (fssai-seed-server.ts:203-212).
3. The pack seeds no assignments (pack.ts:37-42), and missed-check reminders only fire for assignments (fssai-jobs.ts runFssaiMissedCheckReminders). Without a rota, nobody is chased for a missed cleaning round.
4. The pack applies once per pack_key/version (pack.ts:639-645). New questions need a version bump or an edit in the builder.

Discrepancy with the brief: there are 12 templates, not 13. CHK-COLDROOM-DAILY does not exist. It appears only as a placeholder hint (settings/checklists/[id]/page.tsx:1255) and a comment (db.ts:8933). The pack file is unchanged against HEAD.

Inspector visibility:
- Inspection Mode shows checklist rounds only as summaries: name, pass/fail, signer. The list is capped at 25 rows (inspection-mode/route.ts:61), so per-shift hygiene rounds can push cleaning rounds off it.
- Reports show individual answers only when they FAILED ('checklist-failures').
- A passing answer to a specific line (e.g. 'Floors swept') is only on the run sheet, and the run sheet is not linked from Inspection Mode, reports or the module screen. Only today's own runs link to it (checklists/run/page.tsx:655-658).
- Inspection Mode has no section for oil collections, equipment events, pest sightings detail or pest devices.

Smallest fixes that would close most of this lane:
- (a) Add to CHK-CLEAN-KITCHEN-DAILY: sinks; walls and splashbacks; hood canopy (required, not N/A); wet/dry segregation; waste area washed; no food waste near prep.
- (b) Add to the FOH round: crockery/cutlery, water station, and in-service bins not overflowing.
- (c) Write the missing pest-control monitoring template covering cockroaches, flies, rodents, droppings/eggs/larvae, screens and door gaps across the kitchen, plus a bait-station round.
- (d) Add a food-grade equipment & packaging template covering all 7 lines, and a document type for the packaging supplier's food-grade declaration.
- (e) Add a chemicals editor to the pest visit form and show chemicals in the report and Inspection Mode.

summaries.summary:
VERDICT ON "KEEP READY IN ONE AUDIT FILE": the app cannot put these 20 records in one place today.

CLOSEST TODAY: Inspection Mode (/fssai/inspection-mode; API src/app/api/fssai/inspection-mode/route.ts) is the nearest thing. It is a read-only, on-screen handover for management only, with 8 sections:
- Licence and certificates: metadata only, never the scans.
- Food-safety checks
- Temperature
- Deliveries
- Pest control
- Water and ice
- Corrective actions
- Previous visits

The time window is 1 to 90 days, and most sections stop at 25 rows (RECENT_ROWS=25, line 61). It has no print, PDF or export, and no link into any record. No page under /fssai has a print view at all.

WHAT INSPECTION MODE LEAVES OUT: oil/TPC, FIFO/expiry, equipment maintenance and calibration events, waste, the approved vendor list, per-person medical and training coverage, and the detail of how each finding was closed. These live in separate registers or nowhere. The 21 reports (src/app/api/fssai/_p9/reports.ts:158) download one at a time as CSV, Excel or PDF, with no combined pack.

DOCUMENT TYPES (FSSAI_DOC_TYPES, src/lib/fssai.ts:2535-2552), 14 in total: fssai_licence, trade_licence, fire_noc, gst, insurance, water_test, pest_contract, supplier_licence, medical_fitness, food_handler_training, calibration_certificate, amc, lease, other.

NO SLOT AT ALL (only the catch-all 'Other', or nothing):
- FSDB photograph
- Water bill (the alternative half of item 4)
- Approved vendor list
- Waste disposal record
- Food sampling/lab reports
- The authority's previous audit report copy. The inspection record exists, but there is no document type and no upload on the inspection.

There is also no pest station-by-station monitoring record. The code says it should be a seeded template, but none of the 12 templates provides it.

TALLY: 2 CHECKED, 9 RECORDED, 9 PARTIAL, 0 GAP.

SYSTEMIC DEFECTS THAT DEFEAT "KEEP READY":
1. The scheduled 12-month photo retention sweep deletes every document scan 12 months after upload. Related checks: CHK-STORE-COLD-DAILY Q12/Q13 (fssai-checklist-pack.ts:527-528). PRODUCE: /fssai/temperature (filters by log_kind) and /fssai/cold-rooms, plus the 'temperature-log' and 'temperature-breaches' reports (reports.ts:587,660). INSPECTION MODE: the 'Temperature records' section (inspection-mode/route.ts:227-281).
items.missing: The report cannot be split by kind: its text filter covers only unit, area and item labels (reports.ts:613), so fridge and cooking readings come out on one sheet. Inspection Mode shows only 25 readings of all kinds mixed together, which would not cover a week of fridge rounds.

items.section: Records You Should Keep Ready in One Audit File
items.where: STORE: fssai_temperature_logs with log_kind 'cooking', 'reheating', 'hot_holding' and 'cooling' (fssai.ts:2243-2246). Related checks: CHK-FQ-PRESERVICE Q07 core temperature (pack:257) and CHK-FQ-HOLDING Q06 reheating core temperature (pack:292). PRODUCE: /fssai/temperature and the 'temperature-log' report (reports.ts:587). INSPECTION MODE: the 'Temperature records' section.
items.missing: There is no separate cooking/reheating sheet: the report mixes these readings with fridge readings and cannot filter by kind. Inspection Mode is capped at 25 readings.

items.section: Records You Should Keep Ready in One Audit File
items.where: CHK-CLEAN-KITCHEN-DAILY Q01 'Work tables, counters and shelves cleaned and sanitised', Q11 sanitiser ppm and Q13 dishwasher rinse temperature (fssai-checklist-pack.ts:301-334). CHK-CLEAN-WASHROOM (pack:340). CHK-CLEAN-DEEP-WEEKLY (pack:371). Stored in fssai_runs and fssai_responses. PRODUCE: /fssai/cleaning, run detail at /fssai/checklists/run/[id], and the 'checklist-records' report filtered by checklist name (reports.ts:161,191). INSPECTION MODE: the 'Food-safety checks' section (inspection-mode/route.ts:171-225).
items.missing: No print view exists anywhere under /fssai, and no report prints a completed sheet with every answer. 'checklist-records' is one summary line per round, and 'checklist-failures' shows failed answers only. Inspection Mode lists only the 25 most recent rounds of all templates mixed, with no link to the answers, so cleaning rounds can be pushed out by shift hygiene rounds.

items.section: Records You Should Keep Ready in One Audit File
items.where: fssai_pest_devices is a register only (db.ts:9982-10006). Its own comment says routine station checks are meant to be 'a CHECKLIST ANSWER (the monitoring round is a seeded template)'. No such template exists: the 12 templates in fssai-checklist-pack.ts have no bait-station or trap round. last_checked_at is written only when a sighting is logged (src/app/api/fssai/pest/sightings/route.ts:335-343). Sightings are in fssai_pest_sightings, and contractor visits in fssai_pest_services.
items.missing: Add a station-by-station monitoring record (date, device code, activity yes/no, action, initials), either the promised seeded pest-monitoring template or a device-check log, plus a report and an Inspection Mode view of it. Today a 'no activity' check of station 7 cannot be recorded at all.

items.section: Records You Should Keep Ready in One Audit File
items.where: Related records only. fssai_expiry_items.discard_method and witnessed_by cover expired or spoiled stock (db.ts:9724; /fssai/fifo). fssai_oil_disposals covers used oil. CHK-FQ-HOLDING Q07/Q08 records cooked food discarded and its kg (pack:294-295). CHK-CLEAN-KITCHEN-DAILY Q09/Q10 cover bins and the waste area (pack:325-326). Nothing named 'waste' exists in /api/fssai or /fssai beyond a placeholder text.
items.missing: There is no general waste-handover log (date, wet/dry/other, quantity, collector or agency such as GHMC or an authorised vendor, receipt or vehicle, signature), no report and no Inspection Mode section.

items.section: Records You Should Keep Ready in One Audit File
items.where: STORE: fssai_oil_checks (db.ts:9772) holds tpm_pct (NULL when not measured), method, the frozen max_tpm_used, oil_changed and quantities. fssai_oil_disposals (db.ts:9826) is the RUCO register: collector, agency_reg_no, vehicle, quantity and receipt_no, with scans. PRODUCE: /fssai/oil-quality and the 'oil-checks' and 'oil-disposals' reports (reports.ts:849,918).
items.missing: Inspection Mode has no oil section (its 8 sections are at inspection-mode/route.ts:122-529), so these records reach the inspector only through the management Reports screen.

items.section: Records You Should Keep Ready in One Audit File
items.where: STORE: fssai_equipment_events (db.ts:9648) with kinds repair/service, breakdown, deep clean, filter change and out of / back in service (fssai.ts:2283-2292), plus performed_by, vendor, reference_no and next_due_date. Related check: CHK-SAFE-MONTHLY Q09 'Cold rooms, fryers and ovens serviced to schedule' (pack:625). There is also doc_type 'amc'. PRODUCE: /fssai/cold-rooms and the 'equipment-events' report (reports.ts:722).
items.missing: An event can only be logged against a unit in fssai_equipment (equipment-events/route.ts:364), and that register has 0 rows in this DB, so nothing can be recorded until it is filled in. Inspection Mode has no equipment section, so the records are reachable only through Reports.

items.section: Records You Should Keep Ready in One Audit File
items.where: STORE: fssai_documents doc_type 'calibration_certificate', equipment-scoped (fssai.ts:2548). fssai_equipment_events kind 'calibration' records value_before, reference_value, value_after and the frozen deviation. Related check: CHK-SAFE-MONTHLY Q10 'Thermometers and probes calibrated and the result recorded' (pack:626). PRODUCE: /fssai/documents and the 'equipment-events' and 'documents-expiry' reports. INSPECTION MODE: certificate metadata appears in the documents section.
items.missing: Filing needs an fssai_equipment row (documents/route.ts:179-188), and there are 0 rows today. The certificate scan is not shown in Inspection Mode, and scans are deleted after 12 months.

items.section: Records You Should Keep Ready in One Audit File
items.where: CHK-STORE-WEEKLY ROTATION Q01 'First-in first-out visibly working — nothing old hidden behind new' and Q02 'Opened-pack shelf lives being applied, not just the pack date' (fssai-checklist-pack.ts:550-551). CHK-STORE-DRY-DAILY Q02 'Oldest stock at the front, newest behind it' (pack:486). CHK-STORE-COLD-DAILY Q08 (pack:523). Also the /fssai/fifo expiry register (fssai_expiry_items, db.ts:9724) and the 'expiry-disposals' report (reports.ts:783).
items.missing: FEFO has nothing to sort on unless shelf lives are configured in fssai_item_shelf_life, because raw_materials shelf life is blank. Inspection Mode has no FIFO or expiry section, and those rounds appear only in the mixed 25-row checks list.

items.section: Records You Should Keep Ready in One Audit File
items.where: No slot. FSSAI_DOC_TYPES (fssai.ts:2535-2552) has no food lab or sample report type. fssai_water_tests covers water only. The only place for a food lab report is doc_type 'other'.
items.missing: Add a 'food_lab_report' document type, or a sample register (sample, date, lab, NABL number, parameters, result). It needs a report or Inspection Mode visibility, and PDF upload, because lab reports arrive as PDFs and only images are accepted today.

items.section: Records You Should Keep Ready in One Audit File
items.item: Previous audit report and closure evidence
items.where: STORE: fssai_inspections (db.ts:10104) with score, grade, report_no and document_id. fssai_inspection_findings (db.ts:10147) carries clause, due date, status and a ca_id link to fssai_corrective_actions (db.ts:9306), which holds action_taken, verified_by and verify_note. PRODUCE: /fssai/inspections and the 'inspections', 'inspection-findings' and 'corrective-actions' reports (reports.ts:1299,1365,1234). INSPECTION MODE: the 'Previous visits' and 'What was found and what was done' sections (inspection-mode/route.ts:434-529).
items.missing: The authority's report itself has no upload path. src/app/api/fssai/inspections/route.ts has no 'attach' action, the page shows only a 'report number' field (inspections/page.tsx:706) and offers no way to set document_id, and there is no 'inspection_report' document type. Closure evidence is text only: corrective actions and findings take no photo. Any scan filed as 'Other' is deleted 12 months after upload, which is about when the next annual audit asks for it. Inspection Mode shows open/total point counts but not each finding's closure detail.
